The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Post Receipt Inspection at consignee site before acceptance of stores: Consignee. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Sr.DFM/NCR/AGRA . FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Sr.DFM/NCR/AGRA A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. BIS License - The item is restricted to be procured from ISI certified manufacturers (BIS licensee) and pr oduct should be ISI marked only. Firm shall provide valid BIS license. Offers without BIS License may liable to be ignored. B.EMD: i) Tenderers are required to deposit Earnest Money equivalent to the amount mentioned in the ten der document. There shall be no exemption from submission of EMD for any tender or by any tenderer exc ept relevant category as per GEM GTC latest version available on GEM portal on the date of tender openin g. ii) Tenderer participating in the capacity of manufacturers/OEM for goods shall only be exempted from EM D and bidder quoting in the capacity of traders/dealers/agent/distributor/representatives on behalf of its O EM/principal shall be excluded from the purview of any exempted category of GEM GTC. MSEs with Udyam Registration Certificate shall only be exempted from payment of Earnest Money. iii) The tenderers falling under any of the exempted categories and claiming exemption shall have to attac h a scanned copy of the requisite document. Offers of Tenderers who claim exemption for EMD but do not

attach relevant documents in support of their claim, shall be treated as “Offers received without Earnest M oney” and will be summarily rejected. Offers of tenderers who do not submit requisite Earnest Money, shal l be summarily rejected. C. Only manufacturers or their authorized dealers/distributors/Agent/representative shall quote against thi s tender. Bidders other than OEM are required to upload tender specific authorization letter of OEM. If bidd er fails to provide authorization of OEM with offer, then no back reference shall be made and offer shall be rejected summarily . OEM to upload self certification / supporting document as proof of OEM of subject ite m. Here manufacturers or OEM refers to ISI certified manufacturers (valid BIS licensee). 2. Security Deposit (SD)/Performance Security: i). There shall be no exemption from submission of Security Deposit (SD) for any tender or by any tenderer except following: a) The store contract cases of value up to Rs 25 (twenty five) lakh. b) Other Railways and Government Departments. (c) Indian Ordinance Factories. (d) PSUs owned by Ministry of Railways and PSUs for the group of items that are manufactured by them. e)In tenders issued against PAC, OEM in whose favour PAC has been issued. KVIC and ACASH shall for item s supplied by them. ii) Security Deposit (SD) shall remain valid for a period of 60 days, beyond the date of completion of all con tractual obligations. SD from successful tender should be received in the purchase office within 15 days fro m the date of Communication of acceptance with respect to the Purchaser. iii) If the Contractor, having been called upon by the Purchaser to furnish the security deposit, fails to mak e a security deposit within the specified period, it shall be lawful for the Purchaser to cancel the Letter of A ward and to recover from the Contractor the amount of such security deposit by deducting the amount fro m the pending bills of the Contractor under any other contract with the Purchaser or the Government or a ny person contracting through the Purchaser or otherwise howsoever, duly adjusting the Earnest Money D eposit, if any made by the Contractor. vi) Apart from claiming damages from vendors, in case of failure to comply with the contractual obligations, Railways shall record poor performance of the vendors for taking suitable penal action as pere xtant instructions. 3. Failure & Termination i. If the contractor fails to deliver the Stores or any instalment thereof within the period fixed for such deliv ery in the contract or as extended or at any time repudiates the contract before expiry of such period, pur chaser would be entitled to cancel the contract and forfeit the security deposit. ii. Wherever SD has been exempted, for any reason, and the supplier fails to supply goods as per condition s of contract, as amended from time to time, Purchaser shall have right to levy damages from the supplier for failing to comply with the contractual conditions, not by way of penalty, an amount equal to SD amount , as would have been applicable if the contract was with a non-exempted vendor. These damages shall be treated as recoveries outstanding against the vendor and dealt with accordingly. .
